title: COTIA: Concolic Testing with Intelligent Agent
problem: Concolic testing for hardware verification suffers from suboptimal path exploration due to local optima in heuristics, leading to incomplete coverage of corner cases.
method: Agent-based framework using beam search and large language models to dynamically adjust path exploration strategies in concolic testing simulation.
key_novelty: First to apply LLM-guided agents with beam search for optimizing path exploration in hardware concolic testing.
contributions: LLM-based intelligent agent framework for path exploration
Significantly improved branch coverage especially for hard-to-detect branches
Optimized computational resource usage during verification
